newsitem.title: CHINA: Pingan Insurance 1996 premium hit 1.18 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Pingan Insurance 1996 premium hit 1.18 bln yuan.

text.p: Shanghai-based Pingan Insurance Co reported a premium income of 1.18 billion yuan in 1996, an increase of 186 percent over 1995, the Business News reported on Monday.

The company's turnover hit 10.5 billion yuan last year, making it the second-biggest insurance company in China with a market share of 14 percent of China's life insurance business, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
